question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Bull’s-eye

options.text: Something that is the centre of a target

solution:
The correct answer is "**Something that is the centre of a target**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The meaning of the idiom bull’s-eye is "**the centre of a target**".
